mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 43-degree temperatures and partly cloudy skies near Badger Prairie County Park. The ISS will be visible tonight starting at 5:51 PM, rising over Middleton near Verona High School and traveling toward the east southeast near Festival Foods, reaching high in the sky.

For local city news, all four Aldermanic districts are on the ballot for the 2027 Spring Election. Candidate packets are now available at the City Clerk's Office at 111 Lincoln Street, and completed forms must be returned by January 5, 2027.

It is a busy week for events. Today features live music at Bailey's Run and a 50-year craft beer celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Crafty Fair at ART House 360 and more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found in a parked vehicle, resulting in her arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
